gen1.name: Red, Blue and Yellow (Gen 1)
gen1.says: A different method from every later game: the ball sets the range of a first random number; status subtracts 25 (sleep, freeze) or 12 (burn, paralysis, poison) from it; the HP check divides max HP x 255 by the ball factor and by a quarter of current HP.

crystal.name: Crystal (Gen 2)
crystal.says: Catch rate after the ball, x (3 x max HP - 2 x HP) / (3 x max HP), +10 for sleep or freeze, capped at 255; caught when a random 0-255 is at most that. Burn, poison and paralysis add nothing (a bug), and a Pokémon with more than 341 max HP breaks the arithmetic (a bug). Gen 2 doesn't store which ball a Pokémon was caught in.

gen3.name: Emerald and FireRed (Gen 3)
gen3.says: Catch rate x ball x (3 x max HP - 2 x HP) / (3 x max HP), x2 for sleep or freeze, x1.5 for burn, poison or paralysis. 255 or more catches outright; otherwise four shake checks, each passing with odds 1048560 / sqrt(sqrt(16711680 / that)) out of 65536.

platinum.name: Platinum (Gen 4)
platinum.says: The same formula as Gen 3, with Gen 4's balls added.

hgss.name: HeartGold and SoulSilver (Gen 4)
hgss.says: The same formula, except that the Apricorn balls multiply or add to the catch rate itself (capped at 255) instead of being a ball multiplier, so very catchable Pokémon gain less from them.
